title: MeterTap - Pearson correlation one-pole, AbstractFifo goniometer pairs, per-voice tau/deltaC atomics for DriftDisplay
description:
Implement Source/DSP/MeterTap.h and Source/DSP/MeterTap.cpp — lock-free audio→UI metering transport per ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §§7, 9.2–9.5.

Before editing, inspect:
- ~/dev/mike/music/plugins/shred-width metering / CorrelationMeter / Goniometer push patterns if present
- Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.h and CorrelationMeter.h (consumer side expectations)
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §§9.2, 9.3, 9.4, 9.5 and RT contract §7

Implement class MeterTap:
1. Audio-thread Pearson correlation rho of final output L/R with one-pole smoothing ~300 ms; publish via std::atomic<float> (memory_order_relaxed or release OK).
2. Decimated output L/R pairs pushed into juce::AbstractFifo backed storage (~4096 stereo frames) for the goniometer; UI will drain — provide pop/drain API or raw fifo+buffer accessors matching reused GoniometerComponent style.
3. Per-voice drift: 2*V=8 std::atomic<float> slots (tau_v_ms and deltaC_v for V=0..3) written at hop rate; setVoiceDrift(v, tauMs, deltaC) noexcept for engine use; load APIs for DriftDisplay.
4. prepare(sampleRate): set one-pole alpha from ~300 ms; reset accumulators/fifo; no heap growth in process.
5. processSample(l,r) or process(const float* l, const float* r, int n) on the push path only: update correlation, conditionally push decimated pairs, never allocate, lock, or touch juce::String.
6. getCorrelation() const atomic load for UI.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY MeterTap.h/.cpp. Do not wire PluginProcessor or Engine here.
acceptance_criteria: MeterTap publishes smoothed Pearson correlation rho via std::atomic<float> with ~300 ms one-pole smoothing
MeterTap pushes decimated stereo L/R pairs into juce::AbstractFifo storage sized about 4096 frames
MeterTap exposes 8 std::atomic<float> (or equivalent 2*V) for per-voice tau_v and deltaC_v writable at hop rate
Push/process path performs no lock, heap allocation, or juce::String use
prepare configures sample-rate-dependent smoothing and resets fifo/correlation state
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: use mutex/lock_guard or blocking queue on the audio push path

allowed: decimate goniometer pushes (e.g. every N samples) to bound FIFO pressure
preallocated float buffer pair owned by MeterTap for AbstractFifo
process block API plus optional per-sample helper
forbidden: store correlation history with locking std::vector growth on audio thread
depend on PluginEditor types inside MeterTap
